review.gallery: Five distinct Creek Views III images from the original branded brochure. The pool and retail scenes also appear in the branded factsheet. Other Creek Views phases, multiphase images and interiors matching Azizi David art were excluded.
review.location: Official project page corroborates Dubai Healthcare City and Al Jaddaf. The factsheet has a project-labelled regional map and eight launch-era travel estimates. The official page has a different Al Khail Road time.
review.floorPlans: The original PDF has 23 complete drawing sheets on pages 2–24. Page 1 is a cover and page 25 is the disclaimer. Fourteen brochure drawings reproduce the same printed total figures found in this book.

unavailable: A verified entrance pin, independently verified Creek Views III interiors and a current unit availability schedule were not established.
